text: すごすぎて　なみだが　とまらんのじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word means 'too much'. すごい drops its い first. すごすぎて = 'being too amazing'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: とまらん is the old-man and dialect form of とまらない: ん stands in for ない, 'not'. とまらん = 'won't stop'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form ties this to what follows, and here it gives the cause. すごすぎて = 'it was so amazing that'.
